note: No warning problem yet, and no item carries an indicator_id: both indicators below are proposed, measured on every item (place_context, prior_notices_730_days), and wait for Tom to set the threshold before any item is raised to tier anomaly.

indicators.text: A country has more IFRC appeals starting in the last 90 days than its own ten-year rate makes likely.
indicators.rule: proposed: Poisson tail probability of at least the observed count, at the country's mean per 90 days over the ten years before the window, below 0.01, with at least 2 appeals

indicators.text: WHO publishes an outbreak notice naming a country it has not named in the two years before.
indicators.rule: proposed: prior_notices_730_days is 0 for a country in the notice
